notes.title: Release Update 1.6.0
notes.notes:
Added:

 Stand added for mines (You can buy it in Town, you can only put it on the floor in mines and it works as a torch holder)
 Added backups to the game (backups are located to the left of the save slot - B1, B2, B3, backups will be automatically created at 30 min intervals)
 Added Ukrainian language

Reworked/Changed:

 Unreal Engine version updated to 5.4
 Changed and improved physics (should reduce the number of physics-related problems)
 Characters artwork has been updated
 Added some missing help texts
 Some other minor changes and improvements

Fixes:

 Completely rewrote the magic table code, now it should always work correctly
 Rewritten the assembly table code, now orders should always work correctly
 Fixes an issue with the inability to teleport back to the forge
 Fixes an issue with items falling through elevators (+improved physics should help)
 Fixes an issue with items falling through the inventory and the floor (+improved physics should help)
 Fixes an issue with getting stuck in the box near the teleport
 Fixes an issue with buying furnace 2 after furnace 3 (you can't buy it now and stuck)
 Lots of other minor fixes


Thanks to everyone for your feedback, suggestions and bug reports.

notes.title: Release Update 1.5.0
notes.notes:
Added:

 Added new grindstone to the game [spoiler](You can find it at the Royal Castle and it can sharpen sword up to 110% and gives a new double fuller to sword)[/spoiler]
 Added 2 new hammers to the game [spoiler](You can find them at Mithrill Mine and Dragon Cliffs, one with an increased forging radius and the other with the ability to increase temperature when forging)[/spoiler]
 Added 4-slot inventory to the game you can use it in both the forge and the DLC ("F" button to open and close the inventory, "G" button to pick up an item when hovering over it)
 Added teleport confirmation
 Added a new place for decor

Reworked/Changed:

 Migration to Unreal Engine 5.0
 Optimization of the most part of the game (from 30% to +60% increase in fps in the game)
 Reworked the sword needs of customers (swords should sell better now as the game progresses)
 Improved the frequency of artifact sales and fixed the problem with artifact sales stopping in some cities
 Increased bets in the dice game
 Reworked the prices of portal stones and the portal 
 Increased the chance of rare items dropping in the mine
 Improved damascus game
 Reworked some magic effects
 Reworked the system for getting money and reputation (the game's playthrough just got a little longer)
 Reworked rewards for customer orders and reputation for sales at dealer
 Reworked reputation in cities
 Reworked achievement "Maximum level" from level 13 to level 16
 Lots of other minor changes and improvements

Fixes:

 Fixes an issue with the inability to learn the Luck skill
 Fixes an issue with game "freezing" in mini games (darts and dice) and custom orders
 Fixes an issue with game UI "freezing" on decor and interior delivery
 Fixes an issue with magic cauldron functioning (many bugs) and clear stone works properly now
 Fixes an issue with items from the shop begin to disappear
 Fixes an issue with holes in the mine (if you have a hole in your mine, just get close to it and it will fill in)
 Fixes an issue with artifact shelf so artifacts don't fall off the shelf now
 Fixes an issue with sword sharpening disappearing when damascus is applied
 Fixes an issue with disappearance of blacksmith top list forever (will also fix "The Best" achievement too)
 Fixes an issue with multiplication of money after playing darts
 Fixes an issue with ore disappearing in the smelter
 Fixes an issue with missing effects on swords after loading
 Fixes an issue with missing names of magic swords
 Fixes an issue with with a custom sword orders
 Fixes an issue with glitches when forging
 Fixes an issue with picking up an iron jar 
 Fixes an issue with some possibilities to break your save
 Fixes an issue with missing item names
 Fixes an issue with positions of sword parts when placed on the assembl table
 Lots of UI fixes and corrections
 Lots of other minor fixes


Thank you all for the help, bug reports and suggestions, and thank you so much for your support all these years even without our game updates, and we're delivering the biggest update we've ever done.

notes.title: Release of the game in open access today!
notes.notes:
The game will be available today for all (Friday)

Sorry for the many postponements of the release date. But all this time we have been working on the game. Fixed bugs and improved the game.

Thank you all for your support and criticism. All this gave us a big push to move forward.
Thank you for your ideas, bug reports, reviews, this all helped us a lot in improving the game. Although the game is still far from ideal, we will work on it and improve it.

Before the release of the game, we will release the latest changelog.

notes.title: News about the release of the game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we would like to say what kind of situation we have now with the game. The game is fully ready for early release. But due to some personal circumstances that unexpectedly happened, we will not be able to release the game today. This will not affect the development or release of the product as a whole. We are also upset and would like to release the game already but the game will be delayed for several days. Soon we will post the changelog on a new update in which we made a lot of fixes and a lot of improvements.

We also listen and watch all reviews and read all comments. Thank you for your support and criticism. We are considering your comments and it helps us to improve, correct and develop the game.

To make up for these problems we will release the game with 15% discount
